about_the_game:
About TheDowsing / ダウジング

A first-person horror game in which you explore with a dowsing rod.

Story

One day, while casually browsing a news site, I found it in a corner.

‶Blockade of 〇〇 Gold Mine" - the reason was unknown.

What if there is still gold left to be dug up in the mountain that once generated so much wealth?

With this thought haunting you, you make a decision.

You grab a dowsing rod and head for the blocked gold mine.

Relying on the dowsing rod's faint response, you continue on your way.

Vague swings, earth-shaking silence...

But the further they proceeded, the more gold they found, and their dream of getting rich gradually became more and more real.

But that was not all.

Deep in the tunnels, you begin to feel an “unnaturalness” that you cannot describe.

Things you cannot see, sounds you cannot hear.

The dowsing rods no longer indicate only gold.

Why was this gold mine sealed off?

What was it that you really dug up?

In an underground world where exploration and fear intersect, will you be able to keep going until the end?

And - will you be able to get rich safely?

Play time

About 60 minutes

Video Distribution and Monetization

Please check the official StirSystem Inc. website.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a finding horror game. monsters will appear and chase the player. Some jump scare will show up during the game. Some blood stains will appear in the game.
